title: Machine-learning-based neutrino-event generation constrained by experimental measurements
abstract: arXiv:2610.20870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a generative surrogate for charged-current \(\nu_\mu\)-nucleus scattering that can be calibrated to measured differential cross sections without event-level experimental samples. Starting from a theoretical interaction model, we fine-tune the surrogate to a MicroBooNE measurement and show that this also improves the description of observables not used in the fit. The calibrated model can also be applied to measurements from different neutrino fluxes without retuning, while retaining event-level predictions of outgoing-muon kinematics. Our results show that experimental cross sections can directly constrain generative event models while preserving their applicability across different observables and beam configurations.

translated_title: 基于机器学习的、受实验测量约束的中微子事例生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于带电流 νμ-原子核散射的生成式代理模型，该模型可以在没有事例级实验样本的情况下，利用测得的微分截面进行校准。从理论相互作用模型出发，我们针对MicroBooNE的测量对代理模型进行微调，结果表明这一过程同时也改善了对未用于拟合的可观测量的描述。经过校准的模型无需重新调参即可应用于来自不同中微子通量的测量，同时保留对出射缪子运动学的事例级预测。我们的结果表明，实验截面可以直接约束生成式事例模型，同时保持其在不同可观测量和束流配置下的适用性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种机器学习生成式中微子事例模型，可直接利用实验测得的微分截面（无需事例级实验样本）进行校准，且校准后无需重新调参即可在不同可观测量和束流配置间保持适用性。
en_tdlr: A machine-learning generative model for neutrino-nucleus scattering events can be calibrated directly from measured differential cross sections without event-level experimental samples, while generalizing across different observables and beam configurations without retuning.
